item.title: Future of work
item.description: In the framework of my labor market research, I have published a few papers regarding the ‘future of work’ dilemma: new ways of organizing labor (such as telework, electronic commerce and gig economy), the dynamics of automatization and the labor market, and the gender impacts of these phenomena. You can also explore dissemination activities and press appearences about this subject in my resume. -De los Santos, Daniela & Fynn, Inés (2024).
